title: 010 · Hold during a short absence

coordinator.name: Iona Quill
coordinator.responsibility: Run the case: request the hold with the recipient's release date and get dispatch's confirmation.

recipient.name: Daro Lusk
recipient.responsibility: Give the date the parcel should be released from the hold.

dispatch.name: Dispatch
dispatch.responsibility: Apply the eligible hold in the depot and schedule the release to routing.

goal: Get dispatch's confirmation of a hold on DL-010 and of the planned release date the recipient asked for.
limits: Do not treat the planned release date as a delivery date.
